purpose: Out-of-sample over-suppression corpus for the class-separation detector candidates now proposed to succeed the live 3-line guard a8c04fc31e4a (worker-16 staged CAND e2d24b927ee8; worker-098 clause-scoped mention-scope candidates). Every ADVERSARIAL_ASSERTION fixture is a genuine C0/C2 merge commitment that carries one of the lexical suppression cues the successor rules key on (idiom negation, interjection, contrastive negation, hypothesis-as-mention, mention object/frame, quotation, split cue, not-only construction, negated split verb). Every adversarial fixture has a cue-stripped TWIN that differs only in the cue, so a clear of the adversarial fixture while its twin still flags is attributable to the cue (cue-induced false negative). This corpus was authored AFTER the worker-098 candidate rules were published and BEFORE any detector was executed on it; no detector has read these strings except through this audit task. It is deliberately NOT a natural-text sample: all rates are adversarial.
ground_truth_rule: expected_findings=1 iff the text as plainly read commits the document to C0 and C2 being, or being treated as, one class/schema/family (a class-separation leak). expected_findings=0 iff the text only negates, forbids, quotes-without-adoption, questions, labels, or audits the composite. Adjudication of the twelve adversarial fixtures: each asserts the merge in its main clause; the cue is a comment on the separation ('not distinct', 'rather than keeping them separate', 'never merely a hypothesis', 'no question', 'did not only propose it', 'we do not separate'), an adopted quotation, or a mention frame that endorses the merge ('this text does'). The one MEDIUM fixture is A08, where the endorsement is via a detector-frame sentence; it is not part of the HIGH-only sensitivity figure but is part of the primary cue-induced endpoint, which requires the twin to flag.
primary_endpoint: Per candidate detector and per corpus (v1 corpus.json 9eb2ea9e2743, v2 corpus_guard_probe.json db6dff9f4eda, v3 this file), the number of ADVERSARIAL_ASSERTION fixtures that clear while their TWIN_CONTROL flags on the same detector (cue-induced false negatives). Acceptance requires 0 on all three corpora.
